reviewFindings: Dirty settings previously had no navigation/reload guard; controlled drafts now participate in those guards.
Sign-out previously bypassed dirty confirmations; existing editor dirty states now participate.
Global organization-name reload would unmount settings after save; acknowledged settings now update display without triggering that loader.
Unconfirmed PATCH responses block retry until explicit confirmed reload; failed reads retain local draft and uncertain state.
limits: Settings remain explicitly saved; the unchanged API has no revision token and retains last-write-wins semantics. This does not claim settings autosave or optimistic concurrency.
No offline/browser-crash durability or collaborative merge acceptance. A started write may complete after timeout; a timeout is not rollback.
All three jobs and every required step must pass on the own exact final commit; pair external final receipt with source ZIP.
Other editors, settings concurrency/autosave, nested workspaces, wider search/performance/UX/accessibility and21 broad tracks remain open.
Production durability/live-provider/deployed/full-master gates remain separate; CI verifies fixtures and does not deploy.

finalReview: Both single-session and all-device sign-out now use the same dirty/busy guard. Actual all-device session revocation added to the browser assertions. Mobile screenshot waits for the sidebar to leave the viewport; the earlier image captured its transition and is not final visual acceptance.
